_comment: Blue-team detection rules for outcats. Each rule matches log lines via regex and raises an alert. Thresholded rules fire when N matches occur within a time window from the same actor (e.g. brute-force).

rules.name: SSH brute-force attempt
rules.guidance: Investigate the source IP; consider fail2ban, rate limiting, and key-only auth.

rules.name: Successful SSH login
rules.guidance: Baseline expected logins; correlate with prior failures from the same IP.

rules.name: Repeated sudo authentication failures
rules.guidance: Possible privilege-escalation attempt or misconfigured automation.

rules.name: Path traversal in web request
rules.guidance: Inspect the requested path; validate WAF coverage and input canonicalization.

rules.name: SQL injection probe in web request
rules.guidance: Review the endpoint for parameterized queries; check WAF and app logs.

rules.name: OS command injection probe
rules.guidance: Treat as attempted RCE; review input handling and isolate the endpoint.

rules.name: Local file inclusion probe
rules.guidance: Validate include paths; disable remote wrappers; check for data exposure.

rules.name: Log4Shell / JNDI injection probe
rules.guidance: Confirm Log4j version and patch (>=2.17.1); block outbound from app tier.

rules.name: Known scanner/attack tool user-agent
rules.guidance: Automated scanning in progress; consider rate limiting or blocking the source.

rules.name: Repeated Windows logon failures (Event 4625)
rules.guidance: Possible password spraying/brute force; review source workstation and lockout policy.
